shipLog.text: ◆ Station approach. Life support here is maintained by the lowest bidder. MARV has met the lowest bidder. He would like to be undocked by evening.
◆ Crop planted. MARV notes this is the point of no return. The mission now depends on something that needs water and doesn't respond to reason.
Arrived: No Refunds. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Arrived: HD 40307g. The leg cost +4 MORALE, −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The tomatoes are fine. The tomatoes are always either fine or in crisis. There is no middle state. (+2 morale)
Cabin Fever. The captain chose “Let them sort it out themselves”. Noted.
You let it run. −15 FOOD, −6 MORALE, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ Planetary approach. MARV has reviewed the atmosphere. It is breathable for things that are not us. Most atmospheres are.
Arrived: Haven Station (Prices Not Haven-Like). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
The Half-Built Relay. The captain chose “Give them the time”. Noted.
Your ship holds the girder steady while their welders walk the seam. +8 FUEL, +4 MORALE, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ We departed Earth orbit with every item technically fine. I have been watching ‘technically’ erode ever since.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 34% grown, health 91. Temporarily.
Arrived: Second Choice Prime. The leg cost +4 MORALE, −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ A tomato has fallen off the vine. Three crew members have opinions about this. (+2 morale)
The Reclaimer Coughs. The captain chose “Print a replacement seal”. Noted.
The fabricator turns out a seal in the wrong color and roughly the… −12 H2O, +15% FAB WEAR, 2 DAYS. As calculated.
◆ A planet. MARV notes that every problem the crew has had in space was originally invented on one of these.
Arrived: FSS Due Diligence. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Uninvited Gardeners. The captain chose “Let the ecosystem argue it out”. Noted.
You leave the bay to its new politics. −2 MORALE, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ Approaching the derelict. Once, someone looked at this ship the way you look at ours. MARV mentions this only because nobody else will.
Tomato: FLOWERING. 57% grown, health 93. Temporarily.
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
◆ SCAVENGE — +12 food.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
The Company Memo. The captain chose “NOT Corporate Approved”. Noted.
You chose the uninsured route. 1 DAY. It will not last.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived: Outpost Remember-To-Buy-Fuel. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Past the Point. The captain chose “Gather the crew and say it plainly”. Noted.
You call everyone to the galley and tell them straight: no turning… +4 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
Tomato: MATURING. 84% grown, health 100. Temporarily.
◆ The crop is mature. MARV notes this is statistically better than average for this point in the journey. He files this as 'acceptable.'
◆ The ship computer notes tomatoes have real flight heritage: grown aboard the ISS in the Veggie experiment.
